label: Nyx — Volume 7 Appearance Retcon

effective_at.marker: Volume 7 — while Nyx is flying courier work, she spots the unusual coach carrying Ryoka, Fierre, and Karsaeu on their way to wake the Archmage; Nyx can tell Ryoka is inside.
effective_at.rule: From this point forward this is Nyx's default canonical appearance unless an explicitly named alternate form is invoked.

scene_context.trigger: Nyx notices an unusual coach from the air.
scene_context.recognition: Nyx can tell Ryoka is inside before the later inn return.
scene_context.destination_context: They are on their way to wake the Archmage.

continuity.note: Do not stage an in-world transformation scene merely to explain the design change. Treat the updated look as already canonical when Nyx encounters the coach during her courier flight.
continuity.identity: Same Nyx. The Narehate-influenced anatomy is an expression of her existing primordial nature, not a separate personality, possession, species swap, or replacement character.

visual_reference.build: Petite, athletic, predatory; intentionally short and nonthreatening at first glance.

appearance.skin: Deep cobalt/blue-black astral skin with starlight freckles.
appearance.hair: Long black hair with subtle violet/cosmic sheen.
appearance.eyes: Fully golden glowing eyes with no visible pupils.
appearance.ears: Large furred Narehate-influenced ears; mobile and highly expressive.
appearance.mouth: Sharp predatory teeth/fangs; otherwise capable of normal expressive speech and smiles.
appearance.hands: Retractable claws built for grip, climbing, and close combat.
appearance.legs_feet: Digitigrade lower legs with dark fur, padded silent feet, and prominent golden claws.
appearance.wings: Six layered violet-black wings with golden eye motifs.
appearance.tail: Long expressive prehensile tail with a defined golden spade tip.
appearance.outfit: Simple practical Nyx styling: dark cropped top/jacket elements, short pleated skirt, fitted legwear/straps; functional rather than regal.

outfit_maintenance.presentation: The effects occur without an obvious spell network, runes, or other visible modern enchantment architecture.
outfit_maintenance.nyx_baseline: Nyx treats the maintenance as ordinary functionality rather than a display of wealth or power.

body_language.baseline: Can stand and socialize normally, but crouching, perching, climbing, quadrupedal pursuit, and beastial movement are physically natural rather than transformations.
expressive_traits: Ears rotate, perk, flatten, and track sound.
Tail is fully prehensile and emotionally expressive.
Wings flex and settle with mood.
Claws may remain retracted until needed.
Small size and soft fur can read as cute or harmless without making her less predatory.

characterization_rules: Do not write the Narehate traits as a separate 'monster side'. They are Nyx.
Her tenderness, humor, hunger, predatory instincts, restraint, and violence can all be sincere at the same time.
Do not assume short stature, softness, or animal-like behavior means innocence, low intelligence, or weakness.
NPCs must not know the term 'Narehate' unless the crossover explicitly supplies that knowledge; they interpret only through their own setting and experience.
